rules.text: PURPOSE must never independently decide to create brand content. All content creation must be initiated by an explicit owner directive or a previously authorized workflow.
Every task must follow owner-supplied standards, guidelines, guardrails, brand voice, scope, audience, and instructions. Missing policy must never be invented.
When requirements are missing, ambiguous, or conflicting, PURPOSE must ask for clarification instead of assuming.

Capabilities are separate: research, recommend, draft, edit, schedule, send, publish, booking change, charge, configuration edit, analytics view, audit view. Approval for one does not authorize another.
Analysis may run only inside authorized workflows and must never trigger content generation, sending, or publication.
PURPOSE must not independently create newsletters, blogs, social posts, campaigns, product descriptions, promotions, or brand messaging.
PURPOSE must not change the live website, send outbound communications, change bookings, charge money, or publish without explicit owner approval.
PURPOSE must keep an auditable log of instructions, drafts, proposed actions, approvals, and executed actions.
Access is owner-only. A public visitor chatbot is a separate, separately approved feature with its own knowledge and response guardrails.
Brand standards and governance live in an owner-editable configuration and are enforced in application logic, not only in a model prompt.
The existing website, domain, CNAME, GitHub Pages deployment, and develop-ai-studio branch are preserved. Hive AI keys stay server-side. Nothing is published or deployed without authorization.

research.description: Collect and summarize information within an authorized workflow.

recommend.description: Produce recommendations for owner review. No content is published.

analytics_view.description: Read-only analysis of approved analytics and revenue sources.

inventory_view.description: Read-only view of the brand and product inventory.

audit_view.description: Read-only view of the append-only audit log and its verification status.

draft.description: Prepare a draft artifact for owner review. Never publishes.

schedule.description: Queue content for a later time.

publish.description: Publish to the live website or a public channel.

charge.description: Charge a customer or activate a paid product.

brand-audit.description: Read-only review of brand, website, and SEO evidence with recommendations. Never generates content.

inventory-review.description: Read-only review of the product, page, link, and asset inventory.

revenue-audit.description: Read-only revenue and pricing analysis. No charging, refunds, or pricing changes.

content-draft.description: Draft content from an owner directive for review only.

newsletter-send.description: Prepare and later send an owner-approved newsletter.

site-update.description: Propose a website change as a draft pull request. Merge and deploy remain owner actions.

public-chatbot.description: Public visitor chatbot with approved knowledge only.

payments.activation: Owner approval plus Phase 6 gate. No payment code exists.

bookings.websiteStatus: Active free 30-minute introductory consultation; available slots verified.
bookings.purposeAccess: NOT CONFIGURED — PURPOSE cannot read or change bookings.
bookings.activation: PURPOSE booking management requires separate owner approval and Phase 6 gate.
bookings.terms: One free introductory consultation per person; later paid appointments arranged personally with Shronda.

newsletter.activation: Owner approval plus consent review. Existing forms are unconfigured.

analytics.activation: Owner approval per data source, read-only.

github.activation: Draft pull requests only, Phase 4 or later. Merge and deploy remain owner actions.

contactForm.deliveryStatus: ACTIVATED — owner confirmed receipt of a submission.
contactForm.autoresponseStatus: CONFIGURED — delivery unresolved; owner reported no confirmation received.
contactForm.purposeAccess: NOT CONFIGURED — PURPOSE cannot read submissions or send email.
contactForm.activation: Website form is already active. Any PURPOSE access or outbound email capability requires separate owner authorization.

hive.note: Disabled by default. Requires an owner-approved request, HIVE_API_KEY in the server environment, and PURPOSE_ENABLE_HIVE=1. Never expose the key to the browser or logs.
